name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a Measured and Indicated Resource of 103.9 million tonnes grading 59 g/t silver and 0.51 g/t gold (199 Moz silver, 1.7 Moz gold). The company received key environmental approval from Salta Province in April 2026 and is advancing toward a Definitive Feasibility Study.
